scorecard.venue: Bharat Ratna Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee Ekana Cricket Stadium, Lucknow

batting.name: JP Inglis
batting.dismissal: c SS Iyer b Shashank Singh

batting.name: AA Kulkarni
batting.dismissal: c P Simran Singh b Azmatullah Omarzai

batting.name: A Badoni
batting.dismissal: st P Simran Singh b YS Chahal

batting.name: RR Pant
batting.dismissal: c M Jansen b YS Chahal

batting.name: MD Choudhary
batting.dismissal: c P Dubey b M Jansen

batting.name: Priyansh Arya
batting.dismissal: c Arjun Tendulkar b Mohammed Shami

balls.text: goes over the wicket to angle the ball into the right-hander, and Samad still carves the full ball over the fielder at short third by opening the face of the bat, Arshdeep has finished with a whopping 52 off three overs
and again too wide outside off, Arshdeep persists with his plan and will have to bowl another one
that's far too wide outside off, another wide
full and wide outside off, Samad reaches for it and slashes, the edge beats the fielder at short third and runs to the boundary
and that's why! Steps forward and towards the off side to drag a short and wide ball against the angle across him from around the wicket, and slams it high and far over deep midwicket
a low full toss on a straighter line this time, Samad ends up chipping the ball towards long on and once again he refuses the single
Arshdeep persists with the full and wide length and line from around the wicket, Samad lunges for it and gets a bottom edge into the ground towards short fine leg
full and wide again from around the wicket, Samad reaches for the ball and hits it to long off and refuses the single to keep the strike
full and wide outside off, this one is too wide and called a wide
slower bouncer, Tendulkar lets it go by ducking under it, and then reviews the umpire's decision to not call it a wide for height, replays show it is below head height so the decision stands
short of a length at the body, pulled off the back foot through midwicket
drives the full ball hard and back at the bowler, hits him on the foot in the follow through and goes towards the off side for a single
full toss outside off stump, slanting across the left-hander, Tendulkar presses forward and drives to deep cover
goes around the wicket to bowl a full and wide ball across the right-hander, Samad moves towards the off side and hacks it through midwicket
clears his front foot towards the leg side and drives to mid on
clips the ball off his pads for his first runs of the season

good length ball on a wicket to wicket line, Mukul clears his front foot toward leg and lofts the ball in the region of wide long-on, the substitute fielder Pravin Dubey covers good ground to his right and takes a well-judged catch diving forward
short of a length around off, Mukul tries to pull but gets beaten on the bottom edge
played behind square for a single
short of a length at the body, Mukul swivels and pulls through square leg, he was cramped for room
short of a length, Samad pulls through midwicket

Shreyas with the catch on the straight boundary! Inglis tees off down the ground, clubbing a length ball from wide outside off back over the bowler's head. Shreyas has placed himself rather straight on the long-on boundary and he runs to his left to take the catch
extremely wide outside off, cut off the back foot to deep point
tries to cut again and this time he gets a bottom edge that beats the keeper to his left, ended up dragging it from wide outside off to the fine leg boundary
good length outside off, Samad misses the cut shot, didn;t move his feet much
no preventing this six though, Samad clears his front foot and slams the pace-off delivery over the wide long-on boundary
length ball and Inglis lofts through the line right over the bowler's head, the fielder at long-on is very straight though so he can run to his left and prevent the boundary
driven to mid off, fuller length from Jansen
he's made outstanding contact this time, stepping out of his crease to a short of a length ball angling across him from over the wicket and flat-batting it all the way over the straight boundary
tries to flick but ends up chipping the slower ball in the air but it falls safely wide of the fielder at square leg
short of a length and at the body, Samad tries to pull but is rushed for time and hit on the glove, the ball lobs up on the off side
the short ball, pace-off too, Samad moves towards the off side and pulls behind square
good length on leg stump, Samad tries to work the ball on the leg side but gets hit on the pads
finally he makes contact with this shot, gets down low and reverse-scoops a full ball from wide outside off stump over the head of the fielder at short third
short of a length outside off, punched off the back foot through covers
moves towards the leg to make room and carves the length ball through point, there is protection in the deep
fuller length outside off, driven on the front foot to deep cover
the slower bouncer is too high outside off, Inglis tries to upper cut but the ball is too far away
this time he tries to find that same boundary again with a reverse swat but misses
short of a length with width outside off, Inglis slashes hard and gets an outside edge that flies between the keeper and short third
defended on the front foot back to the bowler
caught this time! Pant gets down on one knee again and slog sweeps the googly high, but it isn't far enough, Jansen settles under the catch on the edge of the backward square leg boundary
short ball down leg side, Pant gets down on one knee and hoists it over the head of the fielder at short fine
dropped by Shreyas at cover! Pant hammered the ball off the back foot, flat and hard, straight at Shreyas who spilled it and let the ball go through him
flicked off the pads through midwicket for one more
Pant steps out of his crease and then slips as he jams his bat down at the ball and plays it behind point
driven to deep point for a single to keep the strike
gets down low and connects with the reverse-scoop, lofting it over short third but not well enough to beat the other fielder on the boundary
short of a length outside off, Pant hits it off the front foot to deep point
backs away and cuts hard at a short of a length ball to give Omarzai some work to do on the deep third boundary
fuller length on a wider line outside off, Inglis tries to drive through cover but is beaten once again
good length just outside off, Inglis tries to reverse-swat over short third but misses
clipped off the pads through midwicket for a single
length ball angling towards leg stump, Inglis moves towards the off side and shovels the ball over the head of the fielder at short fine leg to pick up another boundary
carves a full ball behind point and that looks like another boundary up until Chahal puts in a full length dive and saves two runs, fifty for Inglis, his superb run this season continues
Inglis is ready for Arshdeep's length correction and pulls the short of a length ball into the gap on the deep midwicket boundary
the yorker gone wrong, Inglis slams the full toss over the fielder at mid-on and clears the boundary
slower bouncer from around the wicket angling across the right-hander, Inglis tries to ramp it but misses
jumps across his crease towards the off side and pulls the ball towards square leg
flicked off the pads through midwicket for a single
cut off the back foot to point
fired wide outside off from over the wicket, Pant lets it go hoping it will be called wide, it isn't
steps out and hits the ball hard to long on
steps out of the crease and flicks through square leg
played back to the bowler

Arshdeep has caught it at deep square leg but then stepped on the boundary! Short ball and Inglis pulled but not that well, Arshdeep was moving back towards the boundary as he caught it and couldn't throw the ball up in time before he stepped out of bounds
low full toss and Inglis drills the drive to the left of mid-off, that wasn't too far away from Shreyas but he didn't dive
drives away from his body on the up at one that slants away from him from a good length, gets a thick edge down to deep third
full outside off, Pant plays a whippy drive but can't beat point
slashes at a full toss, gets an outside edge behind point towards deep third
short of a length ball outside off, Inglis jumps across his crease too early and then has to wait to try and hit the ball over short fine, he doesn't make proper contact
quick and straight, Inglis drives to long on for a single to keep strike
bowled full on middle and off, Pant comes forward and drives to long off
an appeal for lbw after Pant misses the swat and gets hit on the pad right in front of the stumps but that pitched outside leg from over the wicket
too short and too wide outside off, Pant goes back and slaps the ball through the gap at cover and finds his first boundary
the googly pitches outside leg stump and ends up on Pant's pads, he presses forward and clips through square leg
backs away outside leg and drives the ball to long off
short of a length on the pads, clipped through square leg
the slower bouncer, that's too high for Inglis to connect with the ramp
moves forward and mis-times the drive to mid on
stays back and opens the face to steer the ball to point
Pant plays a half-cut to a good length ball angling across him, cramped for room, the bottom edge misses off stump and beats the keeper to his right
short of a length, pulled to deep midwicket
flicked off the pads to short fine leg, not a good line with the fielder in the circle
bowled full on leg stump, clipped off the toes through square leg
nudged off the pads behind square for a single

Prabhsimran is interested in the stumping/caught behind after he whips off the bails ... Badoni tried to cut a quick one from Chahal outside off but was beaten, that really zipped through outside off with good bounce ... no edge, but  what do we have here? Has Badoni lifted his back foot off the ground? He has! And Prabhsimran has broken the stumps at that very millisecond. What a soft end to a fiery innings, he simply lifted his foot off the ground for no apparent reason and Prabhsimran was ready to pounce on the error.
gets down on one knee and sweeps hard to deep midwicket
nudged off the pads in front of square leg
fired in flat, pulled to deep midwicket for a single

nearly in the blockhole but not quite, Badoni digs it out through wide mid-on, Arshdeep gives chase but it is Connolly who reaches the ball first from deep midwicket, he dives but can't prevent it from going into the boundary
low full toss, Badoni gets a leading edge through the covers for two more
he's in the mood now! Badoni waits for the pace-off ball on a length and pulls it high and far over the deep midwicket boundary
that one clears the long-on boundary, Badoni moves toward and towards the off side and slams the length ball with a full swing of the bat
full ball outside off, Badoni moves towards it and slices over the infield at point with a lofted drive, opening the face of his bat
strays down leg side and that's a wide, Badoni misses the glance
Inglis charges at one that angles into him from a good length and tries to slam it down the ground, gets an inside edge towards wide mid-on
played back to the bowler
huge over for LSG, Jansen goes around the wicket and changes the angle into the right-hander, Badoni waits for the short of a length ball and opens the face late to steer to the deep third boundary
too short and the ball barely rises high enough to challenge Badoni, who moves inside the line and pulls, making superb contact to clear the square leg boundary
the short of a length ball sits up for Badoni who plonks his front foot forward and flat-bats the ball over wide mid-on for another four
beaten outside the off stump
short of a length on the pads, Badoni flicks through square leg, Arya runs to his left from long leg and gets to the ball but then messes up at the last minute with the dive and concedes the boundary
good length on a wicket to wicket line, Badoni dabs towards midwicket and retains strike ... LSG want Inglis to be facing far more than he has since the first over
looks for the yorker but strays on to the pads, Inglis leans across and clips it towards long leg
steps forward to a full ball and tries to drive through the offside, gets an outside edge to deep third
moves forward and plays the ball back to the bowler
flicked off the pads to midwicket, doesn't find the gap, that was a looseish ball from Omarzai
full length angling into off stump, Inglis strides forward and drives to mid off for a single
good length around middle and off, Badoni stays in his crease and blocks

played on! Pooran tried to pull that short of a length ball to the boundary from way outside off stump, he lost shape and balance as he did so and dragged the ball on to his stumps off the bottom edge
short of a length delivery and on a straighter line, Inglis swivels and tries to pull but gets hit on the thigh for a leg bye on the off side
slower bouncer and Inglis is beaten on the pull shot
extra pace and bounce on that one, Inglis tries to cut but is beaten outside off
that's a Baz like shot alright, tries to smash it over the long leg boundary by moving towards the off side and swinging hard, but that was too far down leg side
good length from over the wicket, angling into the left-hander from just outside off, Pooran pushes into the off side for another quick single

good length on a wicket to wicket line, Pooran pushes with soft hands towards mid off and runs the single ... Omarzai has pulled the start back for PBKS, just one run in the over after 16 came off the first
driven towards point off the front foot but he can't find the gap in the infield
the inside edge just misses the stumps! Omarzai angles the ball across Pooran from a good length, he hangs his bat out at it and gets an edge that goes to the keeper on the bounce
this one goes away from Pooran from over the wicket, he lets it go through to the keeper
hits the pads with a full ball that swings into the left-hander from over the wicket, hit him high on the back thigh as he tried to play on the leg side
oops, he's out first ball! Kulkarni steps out and swipes at a length ball outside off, gets a bottom edge through to Prabhsimran and PBKS are on the board
four fours in the first over! Arshdeep goes full to swing the ball into the right-hander, Inglis thumps it over the head of the fielder at mid-on
short of a length angling across the left-hander, Inglis plants his front foot forward and lost through the line, hitting the ball to the straight boundary
banged in short and rising into the rib cage, don't think Inglis was expecting that because he was rushed for time, but he adjusted quickly, swivelled and pulled to the square leg boundary
straighter line, swinging back into Inglis' pads from over the wicket, Inglis tries to flick off his pads but can't make contact
this time the cover drive finds the fielder in the infield
Inglis starts with a sublime punch off the front foot, sending the ball racing to the cover boundary, front foot forward, high elbow ... Arshdeep gave him too much width on a fullish length

maiden IPL century for Shreyas Iyer, and what a time to get it. Winning runs to keep PBKS alive in the race for the final playoff spot. He gets to his hundred by smashing a length ball over the wide long on boundary and raises his arms in delight and relief. After six consecutive defeats, PBKS have finally won a match, and now their fate rests on the result between RR and MI tomorrow afternoon.
dropped with soft hands for a single on the off side
short of a length angling across from over the wicket, pulled through midwicket
gets beaten on the cut by a short of a length ball outside off
pushed through point for a single to give Shreyas the strike

Shedge throws his head up in disappointment after edging the ball between the keeper and short third for a boundary ... was that because Shreyas is in sight of his 100? He won't mind in the least, he'd want the win quickly
full toss outside off, driven to long off, Tendulkar's done for the night, 1 for 36 in four overs
moves across his crease and drills a low full toss to deep midwicket, did not time that well
chipped in the air and just past the outstretched hand of Tendulkar diving his his left
looking for the yorker again but doesn't quite land it, Shreyas digs it out through midwicket
clipped off the pads through midwicket for a single
nearly in the blockhole, played back to the bowler
huge over the cow corner boundary, moves across to the off side and frees his arms to smash a length ball, these boundaries are not small in Lucknow and that went a long way
slower short ball, Shreyas is a bit early on the pull and bottom edges it into the pitch
banged in short, Shreyas ramps it over the keeper's head
heaves the length ball high towards deep midwicket where Rathi is on the edge of the boundary, he takes the catch and then falls over to concede six
good length on a wicket to wicket line, played back to the bowler
too short and a bit down leg side, Shreyas gets inside the line, swivels and pulls high and far over the long leg boundary to bring the equation down to a run a ball

lbw! Tendulkar strikes with the yorker for his first wicket this season. He nailed that yorker, hitting Prabhsimran full on the boot with a swinging delivery as he tried to work the ball behind square, ends a superb innings that came at a crucial time for PBKS
full and straight, driven through midwicket
jumps outside leg to a short ball angling across him from over the wicket and cuts between the keeper and short third
another full toss, he's looking for the blockhole but not finding it, Shreyas moves back and across and swings the ball to the wide long-on boundary
thumped straight down the ground, Pooran sprints to his left from long on and dives to save the boundary
full toss from over the wicket, Prabhsimran moves across his crease to the off side to hit behind square but mis-times towards fine leg
sharper bouncer this time, bends his knees and pulls to deep square leg
short and wide outside off, slow too, enough space for Prabhsimran to free his arms and slap the ball to the wide long-off boundary
driven off the pads to long on for a single this time
full and straight, Shreyas goes hard and straight, drilling the half-volley past the bowler with a flowing drive
the slow short ball outside off, Prabhsimran lunges to try and cut it to deep third, gets a bottom edge into the ground, Pant dives to his right to stop it

sharp catch in the covers! Pretty innocuous delivery, short of a length and wide outside off, Prabhsimran gave it a hard crack off the back foot, hitting it flat and low towards cover where Badoni seemed to take it just off the ground. They are going to the TV umpire to check it. Looks close on replays. Badoni was down on one knee and the initial contact with the ball was well above ground but then his hands dropped to the ground with the ball in it. Did he grass it? The TV umpire feels he's grassed it and so Prabhsimran will bat on
gets down on one knee and unleashes the slog sweep, lofting the ball high and far over the deep midwicket boundary, first six for Shreyas tonight
nudged off the back foot towards midwicket
too short and Prabhsimran pulls hard and finds the gap between deep square leg and fine leg
worked off the pads through midwicket and Shreyas also brings up his sixth half-century off the season, his fifth in a chase
swatted to long on off the back foot for a single
bowled flat on off stump, googly, punched from the crease to long off
steps out and cuts the length ball through point
short ball, pulled hard through midwicket, Tendulkar runs to his left and dives on the boundary but can't save it
short of a length ball does not rise that much, Shreyas short-arm pulls through midwicket
moves back and across again and gets to a fifty off 28 balls by driving a fuller ball into the covers, sixth half-century for Prabhsimran this season
steps back and across towards the off side and slaps a short of a length ball against the angle across him from over the wicket, lofts it to the long leg boundary for a one-bounce four
steps out of his crease, gets cramped by a short of a length ball at the body but manages to pull through midwicket, they rush back for the second
short ball, pulled from the crease to deep square leg
slower bouncer outside off, tries to run it down to deep third but misses
full and straight, clipped off the pads through midwicket
ramps the short ball over the keeper but deep third is fine and prevents the boundary

Prabhsimran charges down the pitch and hacks at a short of a length ball, getting a bottom edge that nearly hits the stumps, Pant collects and seeing that Shreyas has sprinted through, he lobs the ball to try and run out Prabhsimran at the bowler's end, he misses
short of a length outside off, Shreyas stands tall in his crease and punches crisply through the covers
goes back again and punches through covers to retain strike
beats backward point to his right this time with the cut shot off the back foot, cashing in on the shorter length outside off
driven on the up to mid off
flat outside off, Shreyas goes right back and uses the width to cut late, finding the gap between backward point and short third, hit with so much power too
moves back and across and dabs the ball off his pads through midwicket
full and straight, nudged off the front foot between midwicket and mid on
steps across his crease to a length ball angling across him and pulls with power, clearing the square leg boundary. PBKS go into the first time out in a good place in this crucial chase
charges again and reaches for a fuller and wider delivery outside off, he can't make contact
jumps down the pitch and is greeted with a bumper, Prabhsimran adjusts by ramping the ball over the keeper for another boundary
pushed towards extra cover for a single
short ball at the body, Shreyas moves towards the off side to get inside the line and pulls down to the long leg boundary, one-bounce four
driven uppishly towards mid off
first six of the chase and it is a mighty blow over wide long-on! Prabhsimran moved across towards the off side and absolutely heaved that slower ball with a powerful swing of the arms
slower ball just outside off stump, dabbed close on the off side behind point for a quick single
short of a length slanting across the right-hander from around the wicket, Prabhsimran slaps it over point for a single to bring up the 50 partnership
played off the back foot towards point, Mohsin is keeping Prabhsimran on the back foot with his length
moves across his stumps and pulls to deep square leg for a single
moves back and across and drags a length ball from wide outside off stump towards wide long-on
played off the pads through square leg, tidy first over from Tendulkar, nearly had a wicket
punched off the back foot to deep cover

he's got a wicket ... oh no, Pant fails to hold on! Tendulkar hurried Prabhsimran with a bouncer from around the stumps, the batter tried to hook but ended up gloving it down the leg side, Pant dived to his left and seemed to catch it but the ball tumbled out of his gloves as he hit the ground
bit of width outside off and Shreyas punches through covers for a single
good length on a wicket to wicket line, Shreyas goes back and plays the ball to the bowler
good length angling across the right-hander, defended from the crease on the off side
driven wide of the fielder at mid-on but not timed all that well, Pooran tears after it, dives spectacularly, bounces back up in a flash and fires in the throw, terrific fielding
pushed to mid off and once again Shreyas runs the quick single
bangs in the bouncer but it is too high and hence called wide
full and on the pads, half-volley, Shreyas dispatches it to the backward square leg boundary by leaning across his stumps and flicking
he continues and delivers a good length ball around off stump, defended into the off side

attempted yorker ends up as a low full toss, Prabhsimran misses the flick and gets hit on the pads, the ball drops close to the stumps and Shreyas races through, Price sprints across to try and kick the ball on to the stumps but misses, Shreyas would have made it though
good length pitching outside off and angling in, Shreyas stays in his crease and runs the ball towards deep third
goes back and works the ball off the pads towards wide long on
pushed towards point for a very quick single, Shreyas is racing through
moves towards the off side to get inside the line of a googly, gets down on one knee and heaves it behind square and into the gap on the long leg boundary
lines it up and biffs the ball back over the bowler's head but he hasn't timed it well enough to beat the fielder running to his left from long on
fired in flat and fast outside off, Prabhsimran waits and cuts extremely late, beating the diving Mohsin Khan to his left at short third
moves towards the off side and chips the ball high in the air behind square, clears the two fielders running after it from short fine and square leg
cracking drive! Moves back and towards the off side and thumps a length ball on the up as it angles across him from over the wicket, beats mid-off to his left
loud call of NO after pushing into the covers off the front foot
that is a cracking shot off the back foot, Shreyas has timed that cut so well, he had room to work with outside off and he cashed in
fullish length around off, Prabhsimran drives to mid off on the front foot, doesn't time it all that well
stays in his crease and square drives a length ball angling across him to deep point
full ball angling across the right-hander from over the wicket, driven off the front foot through point
too full on the pads and Shreyas puts that away to the midwicket boundary with a neat flick

oh dear, what's happened there? Shreyas punched the ball towards wide mid-off, and the mid-off fielder was moving to his left to intercept the shot, but the fielder from extra cover moved to his right and deflected the ball past the fielder at mid-off and it ran away to the long off boundary
mis-times the punch off the back foot into the covers
played off the back foot towards midwicket, Shreyas wants one but gets sent back.

Shami on fire for LSG! He's uprooted Connolly's off stump! Upright seam, angling into the left hander from around the wicket, pitching on a fullish length, shaping past the outside edge of Connolly's smash down the ground, and blitzing off stump
stays back and opens the face to steer a good length ball towards deep third
mis-times the pull against a short of a length delivery, manages to clear the bowler's head and the ball falls short of mid on
another crisp drive into the covers and this time the fielder dives and manages to take pace off the shot
overcompensates with a fullish ball around off stump, Connolly drills the drive between cover and mid off to pick up another boundary
pitches outside leg on a length, Connolly whips the ball off his pads on the back foot through square leg, Badoni has a long chase from fine leg and he won't make it
stays back and opens the face to steer a length ball behind point for a single
good length on a tight line around off stump, Prabhsimran blocks with a straight bat on the front foot
punched off the back foot into the covers
that's too wide outside off
wide outside off, Connolly chases after it and gets a bottom edge into the ground to the keeper
too much width on offer outside off and Connolly has such fast hands, slashing a length ball to the deep third boundary
good length angling in towards off stump from just outside, Connolly punches off the back foot into the covers
too full and too straight from around the wicket, Connolly whips it off his pads wide of the fielder at short fine leg
pitches wide outside off and seams further away, Connolly lets it go

shocker of a start for PBKS! Arya has been troubled by this length in recent games, banged in short of a length and into his body from around the wicket, Arya goes for the pull and lobs the catch to Tendulkar at midwicket, that hit high on the bat and hard
